description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. The cell walks 5 minutes to station 0, which takes 20 minutes to station 1; the place is 0.001 degrees from station 1 (1.8486182 minutes) and 0.041 from station 0 (75.8 minutes, beyond the 40-minute reach). The direct walk is 0.042 degrees, 77.6 minutes, also beyond reach. 5 + 20 + 1.8486182088824847 = 26.848618208882485.
